data_quality_scope.unit_of_analysis: One canonical case-sensitive Solana mint, its original birth context and one T0 entry decision, not a pool/listing row or client receipt age.
data_quality_scope.capture_grain: Provider-reported creation context plus local original HTTP receipt; separate fresh market collection and preserved queue residence.
data_quality_scope.operational_run_impact: NOT_ESTABLISHED. Native original failures prove software gaps, not missed real buys, coverage or profitable outcomes.

findings.finding: Common original entry never invokes the available creation lookup and defers unknown birth after market collection.
findings.repair: Await a bounded optional creation lookup before collecting market inputs in the single guarded entry owner; independently supervised discovery/monitor owners remain unchanged.

findings.finding: Discovery snapshots, fallback merges and original T0 proofs fail to retain provider birth receipt alongside its clock.
findings.repair: Carry detached identity/creation context atomically through discovery, market merge, retry metadata and original T0 learning proof, outside unchanged predictors.

findings.finding: A fresh market snapshot can replace an existing original birth with a different clock.
findings.repair: Preserve known original clocks and proof through fresh snapshot and HotQueue updates. Freeze typed receipt and reject changed clock, receipt or model ages before buy.

findings.finding: Creation is a separate documented35-CU request; automatic calls need bounded local ownership and absence handling.
findings.repair: Default12 spaced creation reservations/minute,3s timeout,2048-entry LRU,30s negative cache, at most2 owners and same-mint Future coalescence. Missing configuration/circuit degradation/budget/timeout leave birth unknown without detached work or price-circuit poisoning.

official_sources.title: Birdeye Token Creation Info
claims: Solana network and token-address query are explicit
35 CU per request is documented, not operator access or quota proof

implementation.ownership: Existing single guarded entry owner awaits/cancels an explicitly owned provider Task; no autonomous new loop or detached provider worker is added. Parallel callers share an owned Future. Repeated cancellation cannot release ownership before provider cleanup acknowledgement. Timeout requests cancellation and is not a provider cleanup latency SLA.
implementation.birth_guards: Strict32-byte mint and64-byte signature shape, exact receipt/source/network/context fields, canonical UTC original clock and original received_at causality. These do not authenticate chain transaction content or finality.
implementation.budget_scope: Creation-only lookup reservation upper bound12/min and420 documented CU/min by default; all other provider traffic is additional. Cache hits can reserve fewer actual wire requests than the conservative local reservation count. This is not provider billing or entitlement acceptance.
implementation.cache_scope: Capacity2048 defaults, original HTTP receipt never restamped; success lifetime bounded by original receipt24h and negative30s local cache. Existing adapter negative TTL also applies.
implementation.proof_compatibility: Original normalized clock v2 accepts optional checked token_birth_observation metadata. Older v2 normalized proofs remain valid without being retroactively certified provider birth. No generation/model activation, history migration or predictor is added.
implementation.extreme_signal_scope: Actual common entry fixture retains price_pct_5m=25000 after automatic birth collection. Existing applicable uncapped exits and exact0.1 SOL PAPER configuration remain unchanged. Fixture transport is not executed capture or profit.

native_original.scope: Actual C parent modules preloaded before independent initial D tests; native run functions extracted from original C cwd without starting run_bot.

repeated_cancellation_reproduction.scope: Synthetic delayed provider cleanup, not credentialed HTTP or operational runtime.

Test now ignores only those five optional keys in parity and still enforces all other parity, mandatory flags and duplicate checks.

The3s cancellation deadline includes the existing shared Birdeye throttle; cleanup may exceed it. The resolver LRU is bounded, not all shared adapter caches or per-key failure counters. Production throughput and global cache capacity remain independent work.
Provider-reported mint context and Base58 signature shape are not independent chain/creator/finality verification.
Creation lookup is deliberately budgeted and can defer candidates; exhaustive feed or opportunity coverage is not established.
Other providers, historical birth/cohort semantics, longer-regime/creator dependence and complete cross-strategy financial ownership remain independent work.
No fresh full-strategy closed evidence or prospective net profitability is established; no guaranteed winners or zero future errors claim.
